instructions.ru: Выбери слово, которое естественно завершает предложение.
instructions.en: Choose the word that naturally completes the sentence.

instructions.ru: Выбери подходящий глагол для устойчивого сочетания.
instructions.en: Choose the correct verb for the travel collocation.

content.prompt: You should ___ a table in advance.

explanation.ru: Используем “book a table” или “reserve a table”.
explanation.en: Use “book a table” or “reserve a table”.

instructions.ru: Выбери фразовый глагол с подходящим значением.
instructions.en: Choose the phrasal verb with the correct meaning.

content.prompt: The train was delayed, so we had to ___ our plans.

explanation.en: “Change our plans” means to make different arrangements.

success_criteria: Identify the phrase that fits the context.

objective: Use the third-person singular in Present Simple

explanation.ru: С he, she, it в Present Simple к глаголу обычно добавляется -s или -es.
explanation.en: In the Present Simple, he, she and it usually take a verb ending in -s or -es.

success_criteria: Choose the correct third-person singular form.

objective: Distinguish Present Perfect from Past Simple

instructions.ru: Выбери время, которое подходит к указанному моменту в прошлом.
instructions.en: Choose the tense that fits the finished past time expression.

explanation.ru: “Yesterday” указывает на завершённое время в прошлом, поэтому нужен Past Simple.
explanation.en: “Yesterday” is a finished past time, so use the Past Simple.

instructions.en: Choose the correct First Conditional form.

content.prompt: If I ___ time tomorrow, I will call you.

explanation.ru: В First Conditional после if используется Present Simple, а в главной части — will + infinitive.
explanation.en: In the First Conditional, use the Present Simple after if and will + infinitive in the main clause.

success_criteria: Use Present Simple after if in a First Conditional.

explanation.ru: После Rarely в начале предложения используется инверсия: вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее.
explanation.en: When “Rarely” begins a sentence, use inversion: auxiliary verb + subject.

success_criteria: Recognise inversion after a negative adverbial.

objective: Find key details in a short practical message

instructions.ru: Прочитай сообщение и ответь на вопрос.
instructions.en: Read the message and answer the question.

content.passage: Hi Sam, the library closes at 6 p.m. today. I’ll meet you outside at 5:15, and we can study for about half an hour. Don’t forget to bring your notebook. See you, Alex.

explanation.ru: В сообщении прямо сказано: “bring your notebook”.
explanation.en: The message explicitly says: “bring your notebook”.

objective: Understand the main idea and supporting details

instructions.ru: Прочитай короткий текст и выбери его основную мысль.
instructions.en: Read the short text and choose its main idea.

content.passage: Many people think that learning a language requires long study sessions. However, short and regular practice can be more manageable. A learner who reviews vocabulary, reads a short text and writes a few sentences each day can build a sustainable routine. The key is consistency rather than intensity.

options.text: Long lessons are always more effective.
Regular short practice can create a sustainable learning habit.
Vocabulary is the only important language skill.

explanation.ru: Текст подчёркивает регулярность и посильную нагрузку, а не длительность отдельного занятия.
explanation.en: The text emphasises consistency and manageable practice rather than long individual sessions.

success_criteria: Choose the option that captures the whole text.

explanation.ru: Water — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому используем much.

objective: Recognise common places in a town

instructions.ru: Выбери место, где можно купить лекарства.
instructions.en: Choose the place where you can buy medicine.

explanation.en: A pharmacy is a place where you can buy medicine.

objective: Infer a practical next step from a short notice

instructions.ru: Прочитай объявление и выбери, что нужно сделать.
instructions.en: Read the notice and choose the best next step.

content.passage: Your train to Manchester will depart from platform 6 instead of platform 3. The departure time remains 14:20. Please check the station screens for further updates.

options.text: Go to platform 6 and keep checking updates.
Wait until the departure time changes.

explanation.ru: Платформа изменилась на 6, время осталось прежним; объявление советует следить за экранами.
explanation.en: The platform changed to 6, the time stayed the same, and passengers should check the screens.

success_criteria: Identify the action supported by the notice.
